title: OpenAI is already trying to shape the 2028 election
slides: Is OpenAI already scripting the 2028 election?
It's building tools to track political narratives in real time.
But the same system can amplify the misinformation it flags.
Campaigns using it will set the terms of debate early.
Ask which narratives your feed never shows you.
thread_text:
1. The 2028 race has a new player

OpenAI is reportedly building real-time tools to track political narratives. That means the ground game for 2028 may already be underway.

2. The same tool flips

The system can amplify the very misinformation it flags. A filter that also acts as a megaphone.

3. First mover wins the frame

Campaigns that adopt it early will set the terms of debate before voters even tune in.

4. Your feed is the battlefield

These tools don't just watch narratives. They shape what reaches you, often without any label.

5. Ask what's missing

Open your feed and ask which narratives never appear. That silence is the real story. Do it today.

instagram.caption:
A system being built right now could flag political misinformation and amplify it at the same time. 🚩

OpenAI is reportedly developing tools to track political narratives in real time ahead of 2028.

The same system that spots a false story can also push it further.

Campaigns that adopt it early will frame the debate before most voters tune in. 🎯

If you publish content, the narratives these tools surface (or bury) will shape what your audience sees first. 👀

Open your feed and ask: which stories never reach you? That silence is worth investigating today. 🔍
